verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms an llms.txt exists at docs.stripe.com/llms.txt, and Atlas pages are served as agent-friendly markdown (atlas.md returns HTTP 200, and signup.md, 83b-election.md, incorporation-documents.md and company-types.md are cited). An agent can therefore be pointed at machine-readable Atlas docs. Missing for 10: evidence that the llms.txt indexes Atlas content rather than only general Stripe docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agents using these docs.
